description: Portable Windows automation for scheduled tasks, keystrokes, paste actions, cursor movements and system commands.
notes: Uses the official Tasket++ portable ZIP rather than the Setup EXE. The archive places Tasket++.exe inside Tasket++; Scoop's extract_dir brings that directory's contents to the Scoop version directory root.
Tasket++ stores programSettings.ini, programData.ini, sentences, keyssequences, cursormovements, and saved_tasks beside its executable. Scoop persists these paths across updates and uninstall.
Tasket++ can register optional startup tasks and global hotkeys when configured inside the application. These are user-selected runtime features, not installed by this manifest.
